records.jp: ねえ、この辺の異灰って、<CR>こんなに強かったっけ？
records.en_original: Say, have the Testa around here always been this strong?
records.en: Say, have the Testa around here always been this strong?

records.jp: ううん。そもそも、そこまで強い異灰が<CR>いない地域を選んだはずなんだけど……
records.en_original: No. We picked a zone where the Testa weren't supposed to be that tough.
records.en: No. We picked a zone where the Testa weren't supposed to be that tough.

records.jp: 強いっていうか……
records.en_original: It's not their strength, really...
records.en: It's not their strength, really...

records.jp: さっき戦ってたのとはなんか、こう……<CR>質感？　みたいなのが違う気がする
records.en_original: It's just...the ones we fought just now felt, I dunno, different? Their vibe or something.
records.en: It's just...the ones we fought just now felt, I dunno, different? Their vibe or something.

records.jp: 生き物っていうより、ロボットみたいな。<CR>自分の考えで動いてない感じ……
records.en_original: More like robots than living things. Like they're not acting on their own will.
records.en: More like robots than living things. Like they're not acting on their own will.

records.jp: そうですね……
records.en_original: Yeah, I think so too.
records.en: Yeah, I think so too.

records.jp: ご明察、かもしれません
records.en_original: Your guess might be right.
records.en: Your guess might be right.

records.jp: えっ？　あれって……人ですか！？
records.en_original: Wait, is that a person?!
records.en: Wait, is that a person?!

records.jp: なんなのあの子、どうして異灰と一緒にいるの！？
records.en_original: Who is that girl? Why is she with the Testa?!
records.en: Who is that girl? Why is she with the Testa?!

records.jp: あらあら～♪<CR>彼女は私の元部下だった合原舞たんですね～
records.en_original: Oh! That's Mai Gobaru, my former subordinate!
records.en: Oh! That's Mai Gobaru, my former subordinate!

records.jp: は？　部下！？<CR>なんであんたの元部下が異灰引き連れてんのよ！
records.en_original: Wait, your subordinate?! Then why is she leading the Testa here?!
records.en: Wait, your subordinate?! Then why is she leading the Testa here?!

records.jp: う～ん、なんでですかね～。<CR>まあ、久しぶりなので挨拶してみますね
records.en_original: Hmm, I wonder why? Well, it's been a while, so I'll go say hi.
records.en: Hmm, I wonder why? Well, it's been a while, so I'll go say hi.

records.jp: 舞た～ん、お久しぶりですぅ～
records.en_original: Maaai, long time no see!
records.en: Maaai, long time no see!

records.jp: 私のこと、覚えてます？
records.en_original: Do you remember me?
records.en: Do you remember me?

records.jp: もちろん覚えてますよね？<CR>だって、舞たんと私は何度もめくるめく夜を共に……
records.en_original: Of course you do, right? I mean, you and I shared so many enchanting nights together.
records.en: Of course you do, right? I mean, you and I shared so many enchanting nights together.

records.jp: 排除……
records.en_original: Eliminate...
records.en: Eliminate...

records.jp: おやおや……<CR>大分キマっちゃってるみたいですね
records.en_original: Oh dear... Looks like she's really lost it.
records.en: Oh dear... Looks like she's really lost it.

records.jp: ……なに、あれ
records.en_original: What's up with her?
records.en: What's up with her?

records.jp: なっ、囲まれた！？<CR>いつの間に！！
records.en_original: Wha—We're surrounded?! Since when?!
records.en: Wha—We're surrounded?! Since when?!

records.jp: っ！！　直接攻撃するつもり！？
records.en_original: Agh! Are they planning a direct attack?!
records.en: Agh! Are they planning a direct attack?!

records.jp: リーダーさん！
records.en_original: Leader!
records.en: Leader!

records.jp: よかった、間に合った！
records.en_original: Thank goodness, we made it in time!
records.en: Thank goodness, we made it in time!

records.jp: お待たせ！　リーダーくん！
records.en_original: Sorry to keep you waiting, Leader!
records.en: Sorry to keep you waiting, Leader!

records.jp: 手を貸してあげる
records.en_original: Let us give you a hand.
records.en: Let us give you a hand.

records.jp: 今、ライムたちの姿はあなたにしか見えないの。<CR>話しかけないで、聞くだけにして
records.en_original: Right now, only you can see us. Don't talk back, just listen.
records.en: Right now, only you can see us. Don't talk back, just listen.

records.jp: よかったです、リーダーさんが無事で……
records.en_original: I'm so relieved you're okay, Leader...
records.en: I'm so relieved you're okay, Leader...

records.jp: ねえ、さっきのどうやったの？
records.en_original: Hey, how did you do that just now?
records.en: Hey, how did you do that just now?

records.jp: あの子がリーダーに攻撃しようとした途端、<CR>突然白い光を出してたけど
records.en_original: The moment she tried to attack you, you suddenly let out that white light.
records.en: The moment she tried to attack you, you suddenly let out that white light.

records.jp: ふふ。ユズたちの協力技だねー
records.en_original: Hehe. That was our team-up move.
records.en: Hehe. That was our team-up move.

records.jp: あんた、現実世界でも戦えるんじゃん
records.en_original: So you can fight in the real world, too.
records.en: So you can fight in the real world, too.

records.jp: みんな、リーダーへの質問は後だ。<CR>次の攻撃に備えろ
records.en_original: Everyone, questions for Leader can wait. Get ready for the next attack.
records.en: Everyone, questions for Leader can wait. Get ready for the next attack.

records.jp: 時間がないから、簡単に説明するね。<CR>ユズたちは、前にも言ったけどコモンの番人なの
records.en_original: We're short on time, so I'll explain quickly. Like I said before, Lime and I watch over the Common.
records.en: We're short on time, so I'll explain quickly. Like I said before, Lime and I watch over the Common.

records.jp: だから、あなたたちにおける“エーテル”みたいな力を<CR>使って守ってるの
records.en_original: So we use something like your "Ether" to protect it.
records.en: So we use something like your "Ether" to protect it.

records.jp: マイマイの心の中は今、誰かによって<CR>汚染されて、洗脳されてる状態なの
records.en_original: Right now, Mai-Mai's mind is completely corrupted and brainwashed by someone.
records.en: Right now, Mai-Mai's mind is completely corrupted and brainwashed by someone.

records.jp: あだ名をつける癖があるの。<CR>気にしないで
records.en_original: She's always giving everyone nicknames. Just ignore it.
records.en: She's always giving everyone nicknames. Just ignore it.

records.jp: で、マイマイにかけられた洗脳っていうのが<CR>ちょっと厄介なんだよね
records.en_original: And her being brainwashed is kind of a problem.
records.en: And her being brainwashed is kind of a problem.

records.jp: あの子個人のフラグメントを汚染するだけじゃなくて、<CR>コモン全体を侵食しようとしているの
records.en_original: It's not just corrupting her personal Fragment, it's trying to infect the entire Common.
records.en: It's not just corrupting her personal Fragment, it's trying to infect the entire Common.

records.jp: あの子だけなら放っておいてもよかったけど……<CR>コモンに影響が及ぶなら話は別
records.en_original: If it was only her, maybe we could've left her alone. But if it spreads out to the Common, it's a different story.
records.en: If it was only her, maybe we could've left her alone. But if it spreads out to the Common, it's a different story.

records.jp: それで、番人として駆けつけたってわけ
records.en_original: That's why we rushed over as guardians.
records.en: That's why we rushed over as guardians.

records.jp: あなたは、人の心の中に入れるよね？
records.en_original: You can enter people's minds, right?
records.en: You can enter people's minds, right?

records.jp: あなたの力を使ってフラグメントを解放すれば<CR>洗脳を解くことができるはず
records.en_original: If you use your power to free her Fragment, you should be able to break the brainwashing.
records.en: If you use your power to free her Fragment, you should be able to break the brainwashing.

records.jp: 「合原さんの中に入って、洗脳を解いてくる！」
records.en_original: I'm going to enter Mai's mind and break the brainwashing!
records.en: I'm going to enter Mai's mind and break the brainwashing!

records.jp: ええっ！？
records.en_original: What?!
records.en: What?!

records.jp: 誰が仕掛けたかわからない洗脳でしょ？<CR>危険だと思う
records.en_original: You don't even know who set up the brainwashing, do you? I think it's dangerous.
records.en: You don't even know who set up the brainwashing, do you? I think it's dangerous.

records.jp: この期に及んで紳士だな、リーダーは
records.en_original: Even now, you're such a gentleman, Leader.
records.en: Even now, you're such a gentleman, Leader.

records.jp: ……仕方ない。<CR>分担してリーダーを守るとしよう
records.en_original: Fine. We'll split up and protect Leader.
records.en: Fine. We'll split up and protect Leader.

records.jp: 危険だと思ったら、すぐに出て来るのよ
records.en_original: If you feel it's dangerous, get out immediately.
records.en: If you feel it's dangerous, get out immediately.

records.jp: リーダークン、私も同行しますよ～。<CR>舞たんの中は、私結構詳しいんです♡
records.en_original: I'm coming with you, Leader! I know all about the inside of Mai's mind.
records.en: I'm coming with you, Leader! I know all about the inside of Mai's mind.

records.jp: あれ、異灰の動きが……
records.en_original: Huh, the Testa are acting strangely...
records.en: Huh, the Testa are acting strangely...

records.jp: リーダーの洗脳解除、早速進んでるっぽいね
records.en_original: Looks like Leader's breaking the brainwashing already.
records.en: Looks like Leader's breaking the brainwashing already.

records.jp: よし、今の内に畳みかけるぞ
records.en_original: All right, let's pile on while we've got the chance!
records.en: All right, let's pile on while we've got the chance!
